source.text: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח נְחֹ֔שֶׁת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רָחְבּ֑וֹ וְעֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubit[s] its length and twenty cubit[s] its breadth, and ten cubits its height.

en.L: And he made an altar of bronze; its length [was] twenty cubits and its width twenty cubits, and its height ten cubits.
en.B: He made a bronze altar {{units:about 30 feet|twenty cubits}} long, {{units:about 30 feet|twenty cubits}} wide and {{units:about 15 feet|ten cubits}} high.
en.R: Solomon made a bronze altar. It was {{units:about 30 feet|twenty cubits}} long, {{units:about 30 feet|twenty cubits}} wide and {{units:about 15 feet|ten cubits}} high.

es.L: E hizo un altar de bronce; su longitud [era] de veinte codos y su anchura de veinte codos, y su altura de diez codos.
es.B: Hizo un altar de bronce de {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de largo, {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de ancho y {{units:unos 4,5 metros|diez codos}} de alto.
es.R: Salomón hizo un altar de bronce. Medía {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de largo, {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de ancho y {{units:unos 4,5 metros|diez codos}} de alto.

fr.L: Et il fit un autel de bronze ; sa longueur [était] de vingt coudées, et sa largeur de vingt coudées, et sa hauteur de dix coudées.
fr.B: Il fit un autel de bronze long de {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}}, large de {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} et haut de {{units:environ 4,50 mètres|dix coudées}}.
fr.R: Salomon a fait un autel de bronze. Il avait {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} de long, {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} de large et {{units:environ 4,50 mètres|dix coudées}} de haut.

sw.L: Akafanya madhabahu ya shaba; urefu wake [ulikuwa] dhiraa ishirini, na upana wake dhiraa ishirini, na kimo chake dhiraa kumi.
sw.B: Alifanya madhabahu ya shaba yenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}, upana wa {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}} na kimo cha {{units:karibu mita 4.5|dhiraa kumi}}.
sw.R: Sulemani alifanya madhabahu ya shaba. Urefu wake ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}, upana wake {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}} na kimo chake {{units:karibu mita 4.5|dhiraa kumi}}.

vi.L: Vua làm một bàn thờ bằng đồng; chiều dài [là] hai mươi cu-đê, chiều rộng hai mươi cu-đê, và chiều cao mười cu-đê.
vi.B: Vua làm một bàn thờ bằng đồng dài {{units:9 m|hai mươi cu-đê}}, rộng {{units:9 m|hai mươi cu-đê}} và cao {{units:4,5 m|mười cu-đê}}.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn làm một bàn thờ bằng đồng. Bàn thờ dài {{units:9 m|hai mươi cu-đê}}, rộng {{units:9 m|hai mươi cu-đê}} và cao {{units:4,5 m|mười cu-đê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 놋 제단을 만들었는데, 그 길이가 이십 규빗, 그 너비가 이십 규빗, 그 높이가 십 규빗이었다.
ko.B: 그는 놋 제단을 만들었는데, 길이가 {{units:약 9미터|이십 규빗}}, 너비가 {{units:약 9미터|이십 규빗}}, 높이가 {{units:약 4.5미터|십 규빗}}이었다.
ko.R: 솔로몬은 놋 제단을 만들었다. 그 제단은 길이가 {{units:약 9미터|이십 규빗}}, 너비가 {{units:약 9미터|이십 규빗}}, 높이가 {{units:약 4.5미터|십 규빗}}이었다.

pt.L: E fez um altar de bronze; o seu comprimento [era de] vinte côvados, e a sua largura, vinte côvados, e a sua altura, dez côvados.
pt.B: Ele fez um altar de bronze com {{units:cerca de 9 metros|vinte côvados}} de comprimento, {{units:cerca de 9 metros|vinte côvados}} de largura e {{units:cerca de 4,50 metros|dez côvados}} de altura.
pt.R: Salomão fez um altar de bronze. Ele tinha {{units:cerca de 9 metros|vinte côvados}} de comprimento, {{units:cerca de 9 metros|vinte côvados}} de largura e {{units:cerca de 4,50 metros|dez côvados}} de altura.

decisions.choice: the bronze altar: not described in 1 Kings 7
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7 lists the bronze work for the temple but does not describe this altar. 1 Kings 8:64 mentions "the bronze altar that was before Yahweh", which was too small for all the offerings at the dedication. Chronicles gives its size here, at the head of the list of furnishings.

decisions.choice: a very large altar for burnt offerings
decisions.reason: The altar of the tabernacle, made by Bezalel, was five cubits square and three high (Exodus 27:1; 2 Chronicles 1:5). This altar was sixteen times as large in area, fitting the much larger temple and its many sacrifices. Its height suggests steps or a ramp up to it, though none is described.

decisions.choice: he made: Solomon, the subject from 3:1
decisions.reason: The subject is Solomon, who "began to build" in 3:1 and is named again in 4:11, 18 and 19. Chronicles tells the whole work as the king's, while naming Huram as the craftsman in 4:11 and 16.

decisions.choice: Solomon
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject, which the Hebrew carries over from 3:1 (m3).

decisions.choice: about 30 feet; about 15 feet
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the size in feet, with the cubits as the alternative. A cubit is about 18 inches.

decisions.choice: "el bronce"
decisions.reason: Bronze follows the Kings terms note for Spanish, "bronce", through the temple furnishings, as the Spanish of 1 Kings 7.

decisions.choice: metres by default, "cu-đê" as the alternative; numbers in words as the English
decisions.reason: Cubit 45 cm, as in chapter 3 and 1 Kings 7. Where the English writes the numbers in words, so does the Vietnamese, as the parallel verses in 1 Kings 7 do.

decisions.choice: Metres by default ("약 9미터", "약 4.5미터"), the cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: The cubit at 45 cm, as in 1 Kings 7 and the terms note.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַיָּ֖ם מוּצָ֑ק עֶ֣שֶׂר בָּֽ֠אַמָּה מִשְּׂפָת֨וֹ אֶל־שְׂפָת֜וֹ עָג֣וֹל׀סָבִ֗יב וְחָמֵ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ קֽוֹמָת֔וֹ וְקָו֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֥ב אֹת֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made the sea cast, ten by the cubit from its lip to its lip, round all around, and five by the cubit its height, and a line of thirty by the cubit would go around it all around.

en.L: And he made the sea of cast [metal], ten cubits from its brim to its brim, round all around, and its height [was] five cubits, and a line of thirty cubits went around it all around.
en.B: He made the Sea of cast metal. It was round, {{units:about 15 feet|ten cubits}} from brim to brim and {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|five cubits}} high, and it took a line of {{units:about 45 feet|thirty cubits}} to measure around it.
en.R: He also made a huge round tank of cast bronze called the Sea. It was {{units:about 15 feet|ten cubits}} across from rim to rim and {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|five cubits}} high, and it measured {{units:about 45 feet|thirty cubits}} around.

es.L: E hizo el mar de [metal] fundido, de diez codos de borde a borde, redondo alrededor, y su altura [era] de cinco codos, y un cordón de treinta codos lo rodeaba alrededor.
es.B: Hizo el Mar de metal fundido. Era redondo, de {{units:unos 4,5 metros|diez codos}} de borde a borde y {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} de alto, y hacía falta un cordón de {{units:unos 13,5 metros|treinta codos}} para medir su contorno.
es.R: También hizo un enorme tanque redondo de bronce fundido llamado el Mar. Medía {{units:unos 4,5 metros|diez codos}} de borde a borde y {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} de alto, y tenía {{units:unos 13,5 metros|treinta codos}} de contorno.

fr.L: Et il fit la mer en [métal] fondu, dix coudées d’un bord à l’autre bord, ronde tout autour, et sa hauteur [était] de cinq coudées, et un cordeau de trente coudées en faisait le tour.
fr.B: Il fit la Mer en métal fondu. Elle était ronde, avec {{units:environ 4,50 mètres|dix coudées}} d’un bord à l’autre et {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} de haut, et il fallait un cordeau de {{units:environ 13,50 mètres|trente coudées}} pour en mesurer le tour.
fr.R: Il a aussi fait une immense cuve ronde en bronze fondu, qu’on appelait la Mer. Elle mesurait {{units:environ 4,50 mètres|dix coudées}} d’un bord à l’autre et {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} de haut, et elle faisait {{units:environ 13,50 mètres|trente coudées}} de tour.

sw.L: Akaifanya bahari ya [chuma cha] kusubu, dhiraa kumi tangu ukingo wake mpaka ukingo wake, mviringo pande zote, na kimo chake [kilikuwa] dhiraa tano, na uzi wa dhiraa thelathini uliizunguka pande zote.
sw.B: Alifanya Bahari ya shaba ya kusubu. Ilikuwa ya mviringo, {{units:karibu mita 4.5|dhiraa kumi}} tangu ukingo mmoja mpaka mwingine, na kimo chake {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}}, na uzi wa {{units:karibu mita 13.5|dhiraa thelathini}} ulihitajika kuizunguka.
sw.R: Alitengeneza pia tangi kubwa la mviringo la shaba ya kusubu lililoitwa Bahari. Upana wake tangu ukingo hadi ukingo ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 4.5|dhiraa kumi}}, na kimo chake {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}}, na mzingo wake {{units:karibu mita 13.5|dhiraa thelathini}}.

vi.L: Vua làm cái biển [bằng kim loại] đúc, từ vành này đến vành kia mười cu-đê, tròn chung quanh, cao năm cu-đê, và một sợi dây ba mươi cu-đê vòng quanh nó.
vi.B: Vua làm cái Biển bằng kim loại đúc. Biển hình tròn, đường kính từ vành này đến vành kia {{units:4,5 m|mười cu-đê}}, cao {{units:2,25 m|năm cu-đê}}, và phải một sợi dây {{units:13,5 m|ba mươi cu-đê}} mới đo được chu vi.
vi.R: Vua cũng làm một cái bể tròn rất lớn bằng đồng đúc, gọi là cái Biển. Bể rộng {{units:4,5 m|mười cu-đê}} từ vành này sang vành kia, cao {{units:2,25 m|năm cu-đê}}, và có chu vi {{units:13,5 m|ba mươi cu-đê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 바다를 부어 만들었는데, 이쪽 가장자리에서 저쪽 가장자리까지 십 규빗이고 사방이 둥글었으며, 그 높이가 오 규빗이었고, 삼십 규빗 되는 줄이 사방을 둘렀다.
ko.B: 그는 놋을 부어 바다를 만들었다. 그것은 둥글었으며, 이쪽 가장자리에서 저쪽 가장자리까지 {{units:약 4.5미터|십 규빗}}, 높이가 {{units:약 2.25미터|오 규빗}}, 둘레가 {{units:약 13.5미터|삼십 규빗}}이었다.
ko.R: 그는 또 놋을 부어 '바다'라고 부르는 커다란 둥근 물통을 만들었다. 지름이 {{units:약 4.5미터|십 규빗}}, 높이가 {{units:약 2.25미터|오 규빗}}, 둘레가 {{units:약 13.5미터|삼십 규빗}}이었다.

pt.L: E fez o mar de [metal] fundido, de dez côvados de uma borda à outra borda, redondo ao redor, e a sua altura [era de] cinco côvados, e um fio de trinta côvados o rodeava ao redor.
pt.B: Ele fez o Mar de metal fundido. Era redondo, com {{units:cerca de 4,50 metros|dez côvados}} de uma borda à outra e {{units:cerca de 2,25 metros|cinco côvados}} de altura, e era preciso um fio de {{units:cerca de 13,5 metros|trinta côvados}} para medir a sua volta.
pt.R: Ele também fez um enorme tanque redondo de bronze fundido, chamado o Mar. Ele tinha {{units:cerca de 4,50 metros|dez côvados}} de uma borda à outra e {{units:cerca de 2,25 metros|cinco côvados}} de altura, e media {{units:cerca de 13,5 metros|trinta côvados}} em volta.

decisions.choice: the Sea: as in 1 Kings 7:23
decisions.reason: This verse repeats 1 Kings 7:23 almost word for word. There Hiram is the one who makes it; here the subject carries on from verse 1. The Hebrew here spells "line" in the usual way, without the extra letter of the written text in Kings.

decisions.choice: the sea: a great basin of water
decisions.reason: The great bronze basin was called "the Sea" because of its size. Verse 6 says it was for the priests to wash in. It took the place of the bronze basin of the tabernacle (Exodus 30:17-21).

decisions.choice: ten across and thirty around: measures in round numbers
decisions.reason: A circle ten cubits across measures a little more than thirty-one around. The writer gives round numbers, or the line may have been measured below the brim, which flared outward like a cup (verse 5).

decisions.choice: a huge round tank of cast bronze called the Sea
decisions.reason: Readable says what the Sea was, so that readers do not picture a body of water (m2), as in 1 Kings 7:23.

decisions.choice: wording of 1 Kings 7:23 kept; "el mar" (L), "el Mar" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 1 Kings 7:23 almost word for word (meaning decision), so the Spanish Kings wording is kept at each level; Readable says what the Sea was, as the English does.

decisions.choice: la mer (L); la Mer (B); une immense cuve ronde ... qu'on appelait la Mer (R)
decisions.reason: As in French Kings (1 Kings 7:23), following the terms note's "la Mer de bronze": Literal keeps the plain word, Balanced writes it as a name, Readable says what it was.

decisions.choice: bahari (Literal); Bahari (Balanced); tangi kubwa ... lililoitwa Bahari (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording of the Swahili 1 Kings 7:23, which this verse repeats; Readable says what the Sea was, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "cái biển" (L); "cái Biển" (B); "một cái bể ... gọi là cái Biển" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 1 Kings 7:23, whose Hebrew is the same; Readable says what the Sea was (m2).

decisions.choice: The wording of 1 Kings 7:23; "바다", at Readable "'바다'라고 부르는 커다란 둥근 물통"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 1 Kings 7:23, so the Korean repeats it; the same holds through verse 22 where the Hebrew matches 1 Kings 7:24-50.

decisions.choice: o mar de [metal] fundido (L); o Mar de metal fundido (B); um enorme tanque redondo de bronze fundido, chamado o Mar (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the verse repeats 1 Kings 7:23 (m1), and so does the Portuguese at every level. The great basin keeps its name, "o Mar", with a capital at Balanced and Readable, as the English has it, so that it is not read as the sea (m2); Readable says what it was. Only the subject differs: Kings names Hiram, Chronicles goes on from verse 1.

source.text: וּדְמ֣וּת בְּקָרִים֩ תַּ֨חַת ל֜וֹ סָבִ֤יב׀סָבִיב֙ סוֹבְבִ֣ים אֹת֔וֹ עֶ֚שֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה מַקִּיפִ֥ים אֶת־הַיָּ֖ם סָבִ֑יב שְׁנַ֤יִם טוּרִים֙ הַבָּקָ֔ר יְצוּקִ֖ים בְּמֻֽצַקְתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] likeness of oxen [was] under it all around all around, going around it, ten by the cubit, encircling the sea all around; two rows the oxen, cast in its casting.

en.L: And [the] likeness of oxen [was] under it, all around, encircling it, ten to a cubit, going around the sea all around; the oxen [were in] two rows, cast when it was cast.
en.B: Under its brim were figures of oxen all around it, ten {{units:to every 18 inches|to a cubit}}, encircling the Sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast in one piece with it.
en.R: Below the rim, two rows of figures shaped like oxen ran all the way around the Sea, ten {{units:to every 18 inches|to a cubit}}. They were cast in one piece with the Sea.

es.L: Y figuras de bueyes [estaban] debajo de él, alrededor, rodeándolo, diez por codo, rodeando el mar alrededor; los bueyes [estaban en] dos hileras, fundidos cuando se fundió.
es.B: Debajo de su borde había figuras de bueyes alrededor, diez {{units:cada 45 centímetros|por codo}}, rodeando todo el Mar. Los bueyes estaban en dos hileras, fundidos en una sola pieza con él.
es.R: Debajo del borde, dos hileras de figuras en forma de bueyes rodeaban todo el Mar, diez {{units:cada 45 centímetros|por codo}}. Estaban fundidas en una sola pieza con el Mar.

fr.L: Et des figures de bœufs [étaient] sous elle, tout autour, l’entourant, dix par coudée, faisant le tour de la mer tout autour ; les bœufs [étaient sur] deux rangées, coulés quand elle fut coulée.
fr.B: Sous son bord, des figures de bœufs en faisaient tout le tour, dix {{units:tous les 45 centimètres|par coudée}}, entourant la Mer. Les bœufs étaient sur deux rangées, coulés d’une seule pièce avec elle.
fr.R: Sous le bord, deux rangées de figures en forme de bœufs faisaient tout le tour de la Mer, dix {{units:tous les 45 centimètres|par coudée}}. Elles avaient été coulées d’une seule pièce avec la Mer.

sw.L: Na mfano wa ng'ombe [ulikuwa] chini yake pande zote, ukiizunguka, kumi kwa dhiraa, ukiizunguka bahari pande zote; ng'ombe [walikuwa katika] safu mbili, waliosubiwa ilipokuwa ikisubiwa.
sw.B: Chini ya ukingo wake kulikuwa na sanamu za ng'ombe pande zote, kumi {{units:kila sentimita 45|kwa kila dhiraa}}, zikiizunguka Bahari. Ng'ombe hao walikuwa katika safu mbili, waliosubiwa pamoja nayo kipande kimoja.
sw.R: Chini ya ukingo, safu mbili za sanamu zenye umbo la ng'ombe ziliizunguka Bahari pande zote, kumi {{units:kila sentimita 45|kwa kila dhiraa}}. Zilisubiwa kipande kimoja pamoja na Bahari.

vi.L: Dưới nó chung quanh có hình những con bò bao quanh, mười con mỗi cu-đê, vây quanh biển; các con bò [thành] hai hàng, được đúc liền khi đúc biển.
vi.B: Dưới vành Biển có hình những con bò bao quanh, mười con trong {{units:mỗi 45 cm|mỗi cu-đê}}, vây quanh cái Biển. Các con bò xếp thành hai hàng, được đúc liền một khối với Biển.
vi.R: Bên dưới vành có hai hàng hình giống con bò chạy vòng quanh cái Biển, cứ {{units:mỗi 45 cm|mỗi cu-đê}} có mười con. Các hình ấy được đúc liền một khối với cái Biển.

ko.L: 그리고 그 아래에는 소 모양들이 사방으로 둘렀는데, 한 규빗에 열 개씩 바다를 사방으로 둘렀다. 소들은 두 줄이었고, 그것을 부어 만들 때 함께 부어 만들었다.
ko.B: 가장자리 아래에는 소 모양 장식이 {{units:45센티미터에|한 규빗에}} 열 개씩 바다를 빙 둘러 있었다. 소 모양 장식은 두 줄이었고, 바다를 부어 만들 때 한 덩어리로 함께 부어 만들었다.
ko.R: 가장자리 아래에는 소 모양 장식이 두 줄로 바다를 빙 둘러 있었는데, {{units:45센티미터에|한 규빗에}} 열 개씩이었다. 이 장식은 바다와 한 덩어리로 부어 만들었다.

pt.L: E figuras de bois [estavam] debaixo dele, ao redor, rodeando-o, dez por côvado, rodeando o mar ao redor; os bois [estavam em] duas fileiras, fundidos quando ele foi fundido.
pt.B: Abaixo da borda, figuras de bois davam a volta nele, dez {{units:a cada 45 centímetros|em cada côvado}}, rodeando o Mar. Os bois estavam em duas fileiras, fundidos numa só peça com ele.
pt.R: Abaixo da borda, duas fileiras de figuras em forma de boi davam toda a volta no Mar, dez {{units:a cada 45 centímetros|em cada côvado}}. Elas foram fundidas numa só peça com o Mar.

decisions.choice: figures of oxen: 1 Kings 7:24 has gourds
decisions.reason: Where this verse has "the likeness of oxen", 1 Kings 7:24 has "gourds", round knobs. In Hebrew the two words look somewhat alike, and one may have been read for the other in copying. It is also possible that the Chronicler understood the ornaments as small ox figures, matching the twelve oxen beneath (verse 4). The Hebrew of Chronicles is followed.

decisions.choice: under it: below its brim, on the outside
decisions.reason: The ornaments ran around the outside of the basin below the rim, as 1 Kings 7:24 says ("under its brim"). They are distinct from the twelve large oxen the Sea stood on (verse 4).

decisions.choice: cast in its casting: made in the same pour as the basin
decisions.reason: The figures were not added afterwards but cast together with the Sea, as in 1 Kings 7:24.

decisions.choice: under its brim; below the rim
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say where the figures were (m2). Readable puts the two rows first and says "figures shaped like oxen".

decisions.choice: "figuras de bueyes"

decisions.reason: Chronicles reads oxen where Kings reads gourds (m1); the rest keeps the Vietnamese of 1 Kings 7:24.

decisions.reason: Chronicles' Hebrew reads oxen here; Korean follows it and changes only that word from 1 Kings 7:24.

decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:24 in Portuguese at every level, with Chronicles' "figuras de bois" where Kings has "cabaças" (m1), and the same spacing with the cubit's length as the metric default.

source.text: עוֹמֵ֞ד עַל־שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֗ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹנִ֣ים׀צָפ֡וֹנָה וּשְׁלוֹשָׁה֩ פֹנִ֨ים׀יָ֜מָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה׀פֹּנִ֣ים נֶ֗גְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פֹּנִ֣ים מִזְרָ֔חָה וְהַיָּ֥ם עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְכָל־אֲחֹרֵיהֶ֖ם בָּֽיְתָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Standing on two [and] ten oxen, three facing northward, and three facing westward, and three facing southward, and three facing eastward; and the sea [was] on them above, and all their hindquarters [were] inward.

en.L: [It was] standing on twelve oxen, three facing north and three facing west and three facing south and three facing east; and the sea [was] on them, above, and all their hindquarters [were] toward the inside.
en.B: It stood on twelve oxen: three faced north, three west, three south and three east. The Sea was set on top of them, and their hindquarters were all toward the center.
en.R: The Sea stood on twelve bronze oxen. Three faced north, three faced west, three faced south and three faced east. The Sea rested on their backs, and their back ends all pointed toward the center.

es.L: [Estaba] sobre doce bueyes, tres mirando al norte, y tres mirando al occidente, y tres mirando al sur, y tres mirando al oriente; y el mar [estaba] sobre ellos, encima, y todas sus partes traseras [estaban] hacia dentro.
es.B: Descansaba sobre doce bueyes: tres miraban al norte, tres al occidente, tres al sur y tres al oriente. El Mar estaba puesto encima de ellos, y todas sus partes traseras daban hacia el centro.
es.R: El Mar descansaba sobre doce bueyes de bronce. Tres miraban al norte, tres al oeste, tres al sur y tres al este. El Mar se apoyaba sobre sus lomos, y todos tenían la parte de atrás hacia el centro.

fr.L: [Elle] reposait sur douze bœufs, trois tournés vers le nord, et trois tournés vers l’ouest, et trois tournés vers le sud, et trois tournés vers l’est ; et la mer [était] sur eux, en haut, et toutes leurs croupes [étaient] tournées vers l’intérieur.
fr.B: Elle reposait sur douze bœufs : trois tournés vers le nord, trois vers l’ouest, trois vers le sud et trois vers l’est. La Mer était posée sur eux, et leurs croupes étaient toutes tournées vers le centre.
fr.R: La Mer reposait sur douze bœufs en bronze. Trois étaient tournés vers le nord, trois vers l’ouest, trois vers le sud et trois vers l’est. La Mer était posée sur leur dos, et leurs arrière-trains étaient tous tournés vers le centre.

sw.L: [Ilikuwa] imesimama juu ya ng'ombe kumi na wawili, watatu wakielekea kaskazini, na watatu wakielekea magharibi, na watatu wakielekea kusini, na watatu wakielekea mashariki; na bahari [ilikuwa] juu yao, na mapaja yao yote ya nyuma [yalikuwa] upande wa ndani.
sw.B: Ilisimama juu ya ng'ombe kumi na wawili: watatu walielekea kaskazini, watatu magharibi, watatu kusini na watatu mashariki. Bahari iliwekwa juu yao, na sehemu zao zote za nyuma zilielekea katikati.
sw.R: Bahari ilisimama juu ya ng'ombe kumi na wawili wa shaba. Watatu walielekea kaskazini, watatu magharibi, watatu kusini na watatu mashariki. Bahari ilikaa juu ya migongo yao, na sehemu zao za nyuma zote zilielekea katikati.

vi.L: [Nó] đứng trên mười hai con bò, ba con quay về hướng bắc, ba con quay về hướng tây, ba con quay về hướng nam, và ba con quay về hướng đông; biển [đặt] trên chúng, ở phía trên, và tất cả phần sau của chúng [đều] quay vào trong.
vi.B: Biển đặt trên mười hai con bò: ba con quay về hướng bắc, ba con hướng tây, ba con hướng nam và ba con hướng đông. Biển đặt trên lưng chúng, và phần sau của chúng đều quay vào trong.
vi.R: Cái Biển đặt trên mười hai con bò bằng đồng. Ba con quay về hướng bắc, ba con hướng tây, ba con hướng nam và ba con hướng đông. Cái Biển đặt trên lưng chúng, và đuôi chúng đều quay vào giữa.

ko.L: [그것은] 소 열두 마리 위에 서 있었는데, 셋은 북쪽을 향하고, 셋은 서쪽을 향하고, 셋은 남쪽을 향하고, 셋은 동쪽을 향했다. 그리고 바다는 그 위에 [얹혀] 있었고, 그들의 엉덩이는 모두 안쪽으로 [향했다].
ko.B: 바다는 소 열두 마리 위에 놓였는데, 셋은 북쪽을, 셋은 서쪽을, 셋은 남쪽을, 셋은 동쪽을 향했다. 바다는 그 위에 얹혀 있었고, 소들의 뒷부분은 모두 안쪽을 향했다.
ko.R: 바다는 놋으로 만든 소 열두 마리 위에 놓여 있었다. 소 세 마리는 북쪽을, 세 마리는 서쪽을, 세 마리는 남쪽을, 세 마리는 동쪽을 향했다. 바다는 소들의 등 위에 얹혀 있었고, 소들의 꼬리 쪽은 모두 가운데를 향했다.

pt.L: [Ele estava] em pé sobre doze bois, três voltados para o norte, e três voltados para o oeste, e três voltados para o sul, e três voltados para o leste; e o mar [estava] sobre eles, em cima, e todas as suas ancas [estavam] para dentro.
pt.B: Ele se apoiava sobre doze bois: três voltados para o norte, três para o oeste, três para o sul e três para o leste. O Mar ficava em cima deles, e as suas ancas estavam todas voltadas para o centro.
pt.R: O Mar ficava em cima de doze bois de bronze. Três estavam virados para o norte, três para o oeste, três para o sul e três para o leste. O Mar se apoiava nas costas deles, e a parte de trás de todos eles ficava virada para o centro.

decisions.choice: as in 1 Kings 7:25
decisions.reason: This verse repeats 1 Kings 7:25 word for word.

decisions.choice: twelve oxen, three toward each direction
decisions.reason: The text gives no meaning for the twelve oxen. The number matches the twelve tribes, which camped three on each side of the tabernacle (Numbers 2), but the writer does not draw that link. King Ahaz later took the Sea down from the oxen (2 Kings 16:17).

decisions.choice: bronze
decisions.reason: Readable says the oxen were bronze (verses 15-16), as in 1 Kings 7:25.

decisions.choice: as 1 Kings 7:25
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 1 Kings 7:25 word for word (m1), and so does the Portuguese at every level.

source.text: וְעָבְי֣וֹ טֶ֔פַח וּשְׂפָתוֹ֙ כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שְׂפַת־כּ֔וֹס פֶּ֖רַח שֽׁוֹשַׁנָּ֑ה מַחֲזִ֣יק בַּתִּ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים יָכִֽיל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And its thickness [was] a handbreadth, and its lip like [the] work of [the] lip of a cup, a blossom of lily; holding baths, three thousand it would contain.

en.L: And its thickness [was] a handbreadth, and its brim [was] made like the brim of a cup, [like] a lily blossom; [it was] holding baths: it held three thousand.
en.B: It was {{units:about 3 inches|a handbreadth}} thick, and its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It could take in and hold {{units:about 18,000 gallons|three thousand baths}}.
en.R: Its walls were {{units:about 3 inches|a handbreadth}} thick, and its rim curved outward like the rim of a cup or the petals of a lily. It could hold {{units:about 18,000 gallons|three thousand baths}} of water.

es.L: Y su grosor [era] de un palmo menor, y su borde [estaba] hecho como el borde de una copa, [como] flor de lirio; recibía batos: contenía 3 000.
es.B: Tenía {{units:unos 7,5 centímetros|un palmo menor}} de grosor, y su borde estaba hecho como el borde de una copa, como una flor de lirio. Podía recibir y contener {{units:unos 66 000 litros|3 000 batos}}.
es.R: Sus paredes tenían {{units:unos 7,5 centímetros|un palmo menor}} de grosor, y su borde se abría hacia fuera como el borde de una copa o los pétalos de un lirio. Le cabían {{units:unos 66 000 litros|3 000 batos}} de agua.

fr.L: Et son épaisseur [était] d’une largeur de main, et son bord [était] fait comme le bord d’une coupe, [comme] une fleur de lis ; [elle] recevait des baths : elle en contenait trois mille.
fr.B: Elle avait {{units:environ 7,5 centimètres|une largeur de main}} d’épaisseur, et son bord était fait comme celui d’une coupe, comme une fleur de lis. Elle pouvait recevoir et contenir {{units:environ 66 000 litres|trois mille baths}}.
fr.R: Ses parois avaient {{units:environ 7,5 centimètres|une largeur de main}} d’épaisseur, et son bord s’évasait comme celui d’une coupe ou comme les pétales d’un lis. Elle pouvait contenir {{units:environ 66 000 litres|trois mille baths}} d’eau.

sw.L: Na unene wake [ulikuwa] kiganja kimoja, na ukingo wake ulifanywa kama ukingo wa kikombe, [kama] ua la yungiyungi; [ilikuwa] ikipokea bathi, ilichukua 3,000.
sw.B: Unene wake ulikuwa {{units:karibu sentimita 7.5|kiganja kimoja}}, na ukingo wake ulifanywa kama ukingo wa kikombe, kama ua la yungiyungi. Iliweza kupokea na kuchukua {{units:karibu lita 66,000|bathi 3,000}}.
sw.R: Kuta zake zilikuwa na unene wa {{units:karibu sentimita 7.5|kiganja kimoja}}, na ukingo wake ulipinda kuelekea nje kama ukingo wa kikombe au petali za yungiyungi. Ilichukua {{units:karibu lita 66,000|bathi 3,000}} za maji.

vi.L: Bề dày của nó [là] một bề tay, và vành nó làm giống như vành chén, [như] hoa huệ nở; [nó] chứa được các bát: nó chứa ba ngàn.
vi.B: Thành Biển dày {{units:khoảng 7,5 cm|một bề tay}}, vành làm giống như vành chén, như đóa hoa huệ nở. Biển chứa được {{units:khoảng 66.000 lít|ba ngàn bát}}.
vi.R: Thành bể dày {{units:khoảng 7,5 cm|một bề tay}}, và vành bể loe ra như vành chén hay như cánh hoa huệ. Bể chứa được {{units:khoảng 66.000 lít|ba ngàn bát}} nước.

ko.L: 그리고 그 두께는 한 손바닥 너비였고, 그 가장자리는 잔의 가장자리처럼, 백합꽃처럼 만들었다. [그것은] 밧을 담는 것으로 삼천 [밧이] 들어갔다.
ko.B: 바다의 두께는 {{units:약 7.5센티미터|한 손바닥 너비}}였고, 가장자리는 잔의 가장자리처럼, 백합꽃처럼 만들었다. 그 안에는 {{units:약 66,000리터|3,000밧}}이 들어갔다.
ko.R: 바다의 두께는 {{units:약 7.5센티미터|한 손바닥 너비}}였다. 가장자리는 잔의 가장자리나 백합 꽃잎처럼 바깥으로 벌어져 있었다. 그 안에는 물이 {{units:약 66,000리터|3,000밧}}이나 들어갔다.

pt.L: E a sua espessura [era de] um palmo, e a sua borda [era] feita como a borda de um copo, [como] uma flor de lírio; [ele] recebia batos: comportava três mil.
pt.B: Tinha {{units:cerca de 7,5 centímetros|um palmo}} de espessura, e a sua borda era feita como a borda de um copo, como uma flor de lírio. Ele podia receber e conter {{units:cerca de 66 mil litros|três mil batos}}.
pt.R: As paredes do Mar tinham {{units:cerca de 7,5 centímetros|um palmo}} de espessura, e a borda se abria para fora como a borda de um copo ou como as pétalas de um lírio. Ele comportava {{units:cerca de 66 mil litros|três mil batos}} de água.

decisions.choice: three thousand baths: 1 Kings 7:26 has two thousand
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:26 says the Sea held two thousand baths. The reason for the difference is not known. It may have come about in copying, since numbers were easily miscopied, or Chronicles may give what the Sea could hold when filled to the brim, while Kings gives its usual load. The Hebrew of Chronicles is followed.

decisions.choice: handbreadth, bath: a hand's width and a measure of liquid
decisions.reason: A handbreadth was the width of four fingers, about 3 inches. The bath was a liquid measure equal to the ephah, perhaps about 6 gallons; its exact size is not known, so the total is an estimate (Ezekiel 45:11).

decisions.choice: holding ... it would contain: two verbs for its capacity
decisions.reason: Chronicles uses two verbs, "holding" and "containing", where Kings has one. Together they stress the full amount it could take.

decisions.choice: about 18,000 gallons
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the volume in gallons, with the baths as the alternative; the figure is approximate (m2). Balanced keeps both verbs as "take in and hold"; Readable adds "of water".

decisions.choice: "un palmo menor" (7,5 cm); "batos" (22 litros)
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Kings 7:26: the handbreadth is "palmo menor" and the bath 22 litres; Chronicles has three thousand baths where Kings has two thousand (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "khoảng 66.000 lít", with "ba ngàn bát" as the alternative
decisions.reason: A bath is reckoned at 22 litres. Chronicles has three thousand baths where 1 Kings 7:26 has two thousand (m1).

decisions.choice: "약 66,000리터" for three thousand baths
decisions.reason: Chronicles gives three thousand baths where 1 Kings 7:26 has two thousand; the bath at 22 litres.

decisions.choice: {{units:cerca de 66 mil litros|três mil batos}}; recebia ... comportava (L), receber e conter (B)
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:26 in Portuguese, with Chronicles' three thousand baths (m1) at 22 litres each, the size Kings uses, and the handbreadth at 7,5 centimetres. Literal and Balanced keep the two verbs of capacity (m3).

source.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ כִּיּוֹרִים֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַ֠יִּתֵּן חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה מִיָּמִ֜ין וַחֲמִשָּׁ֤ה מִשְּׂמֹאול֙ לְרָחְצָ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם אֶת־מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הָעוֹלָ֖ה יָדִ֣יחוּ בָ֑ם וְהַיָּ֕ם לְרָחְצָ֥ה לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he made basins ten, and he put five on [the] right and five on [the] left, to wash in them; the work of the burnt offering they would rinse in them; and the sea [was] for washing for [the] priests in it.

en.L: And he made ten basins, and he put five on the right and five on the left, to wash in them; they would rinse in them the work of the burnt offering; but the sea [was] for the priests to wash in.
en.B: He also made ten basins for washing and put five on the south side and five on the north. In them they rinsed what was used for the burnt offering, but the Sea was for the priests to wash in.
en.R: He made ten basins for washing. He put five on the south side and five on the north side. The parts of the animals for the burnt offerings were rinsed in these basins, but the Sea was for the priests to wash in.

es.L: E hizo diez pilas, y puso cinco a la derecha y cinco a la izquierda, para lavar en ellas; en ellas lavaban lo [que se preparaba para] el holocausto; pero el mar [era] para que los sacerdotes se lavaran en él.
es.B: Hizo también diez pilas para lavar, y puso cinco en el lado sur y cinco en el lado norte. En ellas lavaban lo que se usaba para el holocausto, pero el Mar era para que se lavaran los sacerdotes.
es.R: Hizo diez pilas para lavar. Puso cinco en el lado sur y cinco en el lado norte. En estas pilas se lavaban las partes de los animales para los holocaustos, pero el Mar era para que se lavaran los sacerdotes.

fr.L: Et il fit dix bassins, et il en mit cinq à droite et cinq à gauche, pour s’y laver ; on y rinçait ce qui servait à l’holocauste ; mais la mer [était] pour que les prêtres s’y lavent.
fr.B: Il fit aussi dix bassins pour les ablutions et en plaça cinq du côté sud et cinq du côté nord. On y rinçait ce qui servait à l’holocauste, mais la Mer servait aux ablutions des prêtres.
fr.R: Il a fait dix bassins pour laver. Il en a placé cinq du côté sud et cinq du côté nord. On rinçait dans ces bassins les morceaux des animaux offerts en holocauste, mais la Mer servait aux prêtres pour se laver.

sw.L: Akafanya mabirika kumi, akaweka matano upande wa kuume na matano upande wa kushoto, ili kuoshea ndani yake; walisuuza ndani yake kazi ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa; lakini bahari [ilikuwa] kwa ajili ya makuhani kunawia ndani yake.
sw.B: Alifanya pia mabirika kumi ya kuoshea, akaweka matano upande wa kusini na matano upande wa kaskazini. Ndani yake walisuuza vitu vilivyotumika kwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, lakini Bahari ilikuwa kwa ajili ya makuhani kunawia.
sw.R: Alifanya mabirika kumi ya kuoshea. Akaweka matano upande wa kusini na matano upande wa kaskazini. Sehemu za wanyama wa sadaka za kuteketezwa zilisuuzwa katika mabirika hayo, lakini Bahari ilikuwa kwa ajili ya makuhani kunawia.

vi.L: Vua làm mười cái chậu, đặt năm cái bên phải và năm cái bên trái, để rửa trong đó; người ta rửa trong đó những gì dùng cho của lễ thiêu; còn biển [là] để các thầy tế lễ tắm rửa trong đó.
vi.B: Vua cũng làm mười cái chậu để rửa, đặt năm cái ở phía nam và năm cái ở phía bắc. Người ta rửa trong các chậu ấy những gì dùng cho của lễ thiêu, còn cái Biển là để các thầy tế lễ tắm rửa.
vi.R: Vua làm mười cái chậu để rửa. Vua đặt năm cái ở phía nam và năm cái ở phía bắc. Các phần của con vật dâng làm của lễ thiêu được rửa trong những chậu ấy, còn cái Biển là để các thầy tế lễ tắm rửa.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 물두멍 열 개를 만들어 다섯은 오른쪽에, 다섯은 왼쪽에 두어 그 안에서 씻게 했다. 번제의 일을 그 안에서 헹구었다. 그러나 바다는 제사장들이 그 안에서 씻기 위한 것이었다.
ko.B: 그는 또 씻는 데 쓸 물두멍 열 개를 만들어 다섯은 남쪽에, 다섯은 북쪽에 두었다. 거기서 번제에 쓰는 것들을 헹구었다. 그러나 바다는 제사장들이 씻는 데 썼다.
ko.R: 그는 씻는 데 쓸 물두멍 열 개를 만들었다. 그는 다섯은 남쪽에, 다섯은 북쪽에 두었다. 번제로 바칠 짐승의 고기를 이 물두멍에서 씻었다. 그러나 바다는 제사장들이 몸을 씻는 데 썼다.

pt.L: E fez dez pias, e pôs cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda, para lavar nelas; enxaguavam nelas a obra do holocausto; mas o mar [era] para os sacerdotes se lavarem nele.
pt.B: Ele fez também dez pias para lavar e pôs cinco no lado sul e cinco no lado norte. Nelas se enxaguava o que era usado para o holocausto, mas o Mar era para os sacerdotes se lavarem.
pt.R: Ele fez dez bacias grandes para lavar. Pôs cinco no lado sul e cinco no lado norte. Nessas bacias se lavavam as partes dos animais para os holocaustos, mas o Mar era para os sacerdotes se lavarem.

decisions.choice: the work of the burnt offering: what was prepared for it
decisions.reason: "The work of the burnt offering" means the things made ready for it. The law says the inner parts and legs of the animal were washed before being burned (Leviticus 1:9, 13).

decisions.choice: basins for the offerings, the Sea for the priests
decisions.reason: In the tabernacle one bronze basin served the priests for washing their hands and feet (Exodus 30:17-21). In the temple the work was divided: the ten basins on their stands for rinsing the offerings, and the Sea for the priests. 1 Kings 7:38-39 tells of the basins and their stands but does not give their use.

decisions.choice: right and left: the south and north sides
decisions.reason: The temple faced east, so seen from inside looking out the right is the south and the left the north (verse 10; 1 Kings 7:39).

decisions.choice: a shortened account of the basins and stands
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:27-39 describes at length the ten wheeled stands and their basins. Chronicles names the basins here and the stands only in its list (verse 14).

decisions.choice: south side; north side
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "south" and "north" for right and left (m3), as 1 Kings 7:39 does. Literal keeps "right" and "left".

decisions.choice: the parts of the animals
decisions.reason: Readable says what was rinsed (m1).

decisions.choice: "el lado sur", "el lado norte" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and the Spanish of 1 Kings 7:39: the temple faced east, so the right is the south; Literal keeps "derecha" and "izquierda".

decisions.choice: "phía nam", "phía bắc" (B, R) for right and left
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 7:39: facing east, the right is the south (m3). Literal keeps "bên phải" and "bên trái".

decisions.choice: "남쪽", "북쪽" (B, R) for "right" and "left"; "물두멍" for the basins
decisions.reason: Facing east, right is south and left is north, as the English Balanced says; "물두멍" is the word for the washing basins of the sanctuary.

decisions.choice: as pias (L, B), as bacias grandes (R); à direita, à esquerda (L), no lado sul, no lado norte (B, R)
decisions.reason: The washing basins (m2) take the words 1 Kings 7:38 sets in Portuguese, "pias" and "bacias grandes", kept apart from the "bacias" for the blood (verse 8). Balanced and Readable say south and north for right and left (m3), as the English and 1 Kings 7:39 do.

source.text: וַ֠יַּעַשׂ אֶת־מְנֹר֧וֹת הַזָּהָ֛ב עֶ֖שֶׂר כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם וַיִּתֵּן֙ בַּֽהֵיכָ֔ל חָמֵ֥שׁ מִיָּמִ֖ין וְחָמֵ֥שׁ מִשְּׂמֹֽאול׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he made lampstands of the gold, ten, according to their ordinance, and he put [them] in the temple, five on [the] right and five on [the] left.

en.L: And he made the ten lampstands of gold according to their ordinance, and he put [them] in the temple, five on the right and five on the left.
en.B: He made the ten gold lampstands as they were prescribed and put them in the main hall, five along the south side and five along the north.
en.R: He made ten gold lampstands in the way the law said they should be made. He put them in the main room of the temple, five along the south wall and five along the north wall.

es.L: E hizo los diez candelabros de oro según su ordenanza, y [los] puso en el templo, cinco a la derecha y cinco a la izquierda.
es.B: Hizo los diez candelabros de oro como estaba prescrito y los puso en la sala principal, cinco en el lado sur y cinco en el norte.
es.R: Hizo diez candelabros de oro tal como la ley decía que debían hacerse. Los puso en la sala principal del templo, cinco a lo largo de la pared sur y cinco a lo largo de la pared norte.

fr.L: Et il fit les dix chandeliers d’or selon leur règle, et il [les] mit dans le temple, cinq à droite et cinq à gauche.
fr.B: Il fit les dix chandeliers d’or tels qu’ils étaient prescrits et les mit dans la grande salle, cinq du côté sud et cinq du côté nord.
fr.R: Il a fait dix chandeliers en or comme la loi disait de les faire. Il les a placés dans la salle principale du temple, cinq le long du mur sud et cinq le long du mur nord.

sw.L: Akafanya vinara vya taa vya dhahabu kumi kwa kufuata agizo lake, akaviweka katika ukumbi, vitano upande wa kuume na vitano upande wa kushoto.
sw.B: Alifanya vinara kumi vya taa vya dhahabu kama ilivyoagizwa, akaviweka katika ukumbi mkuu, vitano upande wa kusini na vitano upande wa kaskazini.
sw.R: Alifanya vinara kumi vya taa vya dhahabu kwa jinsi sheria ilivyoagiza vifanywe. Akaviweka katika chumba kikuu cha hekalu, vitano kando ya ukuta wa kusini na vitano kando ya ukuta wa kaskazini.

vi.L: Vua làm mười chân đèn bằng vàng theo quy định của chúng, và đặt [chúng] trong đền thờ, năm cái bên phải và năm cái bên trái.
vi.B: Vua làm mười chân đèn bằng vàng đúng như đã quy định và đặt trong chính điện, năm cái dọc phía nam và năm cái dọc phía bắc.
vi.R: Vua làm mười chân đèn bằng vàng đúng như luật pháp đã dạy. Vua đặt chúng trong gian chính của đền thờ, năm cái dọc theo tường phía nam và năm cái dọc theo tường phía bắc.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 금 등잔대 열 개를 그 규례대로 만들어 성소에 두었는데, 다섯은 오른쪽에, 다섯은 왼쪽에 [두었다].
ko.B: 그는 규정대로 금 등잔대 열 개를 만들어 본당에 두었는데, 다섯은 남쪽에, 다섯은 북쪽에 두었다.
ko.R: 그는 율법에 정한 대로 금 등잔대 열 개를 만들었다. 그리고 성전 큰 방의 남쪽 벽을 따라 다섯, 북쪽 벽을 따라 다섯을 두었다.

pt.L: E fez os dez candelabros de ouro conforme a sua ordenança, e [os] pôs no templo, cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda.
pt.B: Ele fez os dez candelabros de ouro conforme o que estava prescrito e os pôs no salão principal, cinco no lado sul e cinco no lado norte.
pt.R: Ele fez dez candelabros de ouro do jeito que a lei mandava. Ele os pôs na sala principal do templo, cinco junto à parede sul e cinco junto à parede norte.

decisions.choice: according to their ordinance: made as the law prescribed
decisions.reason: The lampstands were made after the pattern given for the lampstand of the tabernacle (Exodus 25:31-40). The same phrase is used for their lamps in verse 20.

decisions.choice: the temple: the main hall
decisions.reason: The word names the large front room of the house, in front of the inner room, as in 1 Kings 6:3, 17. The lampstands stood there, in front of the inner room (verse 20).

decisions.choice: ten lampstands: in place of the tabernacle's one
decisions.reason: The tabernacle had one golden lampstand with seven lamps (Exodus 25:31-40). Solomon's temple had ten, as 1 Kings 7:49 also says.

decisions.choice: main hall; main room; south side; north
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "main hall" (Readable "main room of the temple") for the large room (m2), as 1 Kings 7:50, and "south" and "north" for right and left (verse 6).

decisions.choice: "el templo" (L); "la sala principal" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word names the main hall (meaning decision); Literal says "el templo", as the English does, and Balanced and Readable "la sala principal", as the Spanish of 1 Kings 6.

decisions.choice: ukumbi (Literal); ukumbi mkuu (Balanced); chumba kikuu cha hekalu (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word *heikal* names the main hall here, and the Swahili 1 Kings 6-7 gives it these words at each level; "hekalu" is kept for the whole building.

decisions.choice: "성소" (L), "본당" (B), "성전 큰 방" (R) for *heikhal*
decisions.reason: The word here is the main hall, not the whole temple; Balanced and Readable use the words of 1 Kings 6:3.

decisions.choice: os candelabros; o templo (L), o salão principal (B), a sala principal do templo (R)
decisions.reason: "Candelabro" as 1 Kings 7:49 and Exodus 25:31 in Portuguese. Literal says "o templo" for the word that names the main hall (m2), as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable name the room as 1 Kings 6:3 does in Portuguese.

source.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שֻׁלְחָנוֹת֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַיַּנַּח֙ בַּֽהֵיכָ֔ל חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה מִיָּמִ֖ין וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה מִשְּׂמֹ֑אול וַיַּ֛עַשׂ מִזְרְקֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב מֵאָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made tables ten, and he placed [them] in [the] temple, five on [the] right and five on [the] left; and he made bowls of gold, a hundred.

en.L: And he made ten tables, and he placed [them] in the temple, five on the right and five on the left. And he made a hundred bowls of gold.
en.B: He made ten tables and placed them in the main hall, five along the south side and five along the north. He also made one hundred sprinkling bowls of gold.
en.R: He made ten tables and put them in the main room of the temple, five along the south wall and five along the north wall. He also made a hundred gold bowls for sprinkling.

es.L: E hizo diez mesas, y [las] colocó en el templo, cinco a la derecha y cinco a la izquierda. E hizo cien tazones de oro.
es.B: Hizo diez mesas y las colocó en la sala principal, cinco en el lado sur y cinco en el norte. Hizo también cien tazones de oro para rociar.
es.R: Hizo diez mesas y las puso en la sala principal del templo, cinco a lo largo de la pared sur y cinco a lo largo de la pared norte. También hizo cien tazones de oro para rociar.

fr.L: Et il fit dix tables, et il [les] plaça dans le temple, cinq à droite et cinq à gauche. Et il fit cent coupes d’or.
fr.B: Il fit dix tables et les plaça dans la grande salle, cinq du côté sud et cinq du côté nord. Il fit aussi cent coupes à aspersion en or.
fr.R: Il a fait dix tables et il les a placées dans la salle principale du temple, cinq le long du mur sud et cinq le long du mur nord. Il a aussi fait cent coupes en or pour l’aspersion.

sw.L: Akafanya meza kumi, akaziweka katika ukumbi, tano upande wa kuume na tano upande wa kushoto. Akafanya mabakuli 100 ya dhahabu.
sw.B: Alifanya meza kumi akaziweka katika ukumbi mkuu, tano upande wa kusini na tano upande wa kaskazini. Akafanya pia mabakuli 100 ya dhahabu ya kunyunyizia.
sw.R: Alifanya meza kumi akaziweka katika chumba kikuu cha hekalu, tano kando ya ukuta wa kusini na tano kando ya ukuta wa kaskazini. Akafanya pia mabakuli 100 ya dhahabu ya kunyunyizia.

vi.L: Vua làm mười cái bàn và đặt [chúng] trong đền thờ, năm cái bên phải và năm cái bên trái. Vua cũng làm một trăm cái bát bằng vàng.
vi.B: Vua làm mười cái bàn và đặt trong chính điện, năm cái dọc phía nam và năm cái dọc phía bắc. Vua cũng làm một trăm cái bát rảy nước bằng vàng.
vi.R: Vua làm mười cái bàn và đặt trong gian chính của đền thờ, năm cái dọc theo tường phía nam và năm cái dọc theo tường phía bắc. Vua cũng làm một trăm cái bát bằng vàng dùng để rảy.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 상 열 개를 만들어 성소에 두었는데, 다섯은 오른쪽에, 다섯은 왼쪽에 [두었다]. 그리고 그가 금 대접 백 개를 만들었다.
ko.B: 그는 상 열 개를 만들어 본당에 두었는데, 다섯은 남쪽에, 다섯은 북쪽에 두었다. 그는 또 피 뿌리는 금 대접 백 개를 만들었다.
ko.R: 그는 상 열 개를 만들어 성전 큰 방의 남쪽 벽을 따라 다섯, 북쪽 벽을 따라 다섯을 두었다. 그리고 피를 뿌릴 때 쓰는 금 대접 백 개도 만들었다.

pt.L: E fez dez mesas e [as] colocou no templo, cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda. E fez cem bacias de ouro.
pt.B: Ele fez dez mesas e as colocou no salão principal, cinco no lado sul e cinco no lado norte. Fez também cem bacias de ouro para aspergir.
pt.R: Ele fez dez mesas e as pôs na sala principal do templo, cinco junto à parede sul e cinco junto à parede norte. Também fez cem bacias de ouro para aspergir o sangue.

decisions.choice: ten tables: 1 Kings 7:48 names one
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:48 names one gold table for the bread of the Presence. Chronicles speaks of ten tables here and of "the tables" for that bread in verse 19 (also 1 Chronicles 28:16). The text does not say whether all ten held the bread or whether some were for other uses.

decisions.choice: bowls: vessels for the blood of the offerings
decisions.reason: These bowls caught the blood of the sacrifices, which was then sprinkled or splashed on the altar (Exodus 24:6; Leviticus 1:5). The word is the one in verses 11 and 22.

decisions.choice: sprinkling bowls; bowls for sprinkling
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the bowls were for (m2), as 1 Kings 7:40 does; "south" and "north" for right and left as in verse 6.

decisions.choice: "tazones ... para rociar"
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and the Spanish of 1 Kings 7:40: the bowls held the blood that was sprinkled.

decisions.choice: as bacias (L), as bacias para aspergir (B), as bacias para aspergir o sangue (R)
decisions.reason: The bowls for the blood (m2) take the words of 1 Kings 7:40 and Exodus 27:3 in Portuguese; the same in verses 11 and 22.

source.text: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ֙ חֲצַ֣ר הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים וְהָעֲזָרָ֖ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֑ה וּדְלָת֧וֹת לָעֲזָרָ֛ה וְדַלְתוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם צִפָּ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made [the] court of the priests and the great court, and doors for the court, and their doors he overlaid [with] bronze.

en.L: And he made the court of the priests and the great court, and doors for the court; and he overlaid their doors [with] bronze.
en.B: He made the court of the priests and the great court, with doors for the court, and he overlaid their doors with bronze.
en.R: He made the courtyard for the priests and the large outer courtyard. He made doors for the outer courtyard and covered them with bronze.

es.L: E hizo el atrio de los sacerdotes y el atrio grande, y puertas para el atrio; y sus puertas las revistió [de] bronce.
es.B: Hizo el atrio de los sacerdotes y el atrio grande, con puertas para el atrio, y revistió de bronce sus puertas.
es.R: Hizo el patio de los sacerdotes y el gran patio exterior. Hizo puertas para el patio exterior y las cubrió con bronce.

fr.L: Et il fit le parvis des prêtres et la grande cour, et des portes pour la cour ; et il recouvrit leurs portes de bronze.
fr.B: Il fit le parvis des prêtres et la grande cour, avec des portes pour la cour, et il recouvrit leurs portes de bronze.
fr.R: Il a fait la cour réservée aux prêtres et la grande cour extérieure. Il a fait des portes pour la cour extérieure et il les a couvertes de bronze.

sw.L: Akafanya ua wa makuhani, na ua mkubwa, na milango ya ua; na milango yake akaifunika [kwa] shaba.
sw.B: Alifanya ua wa makuhani na ua mkubwa, pamoja na milango ya ua huo, akaifunika milango yake kwa shaba.
sw.R: Alifanya ua wa makuhani na ua mkubwa wa nje. Akafanya milango ya ua wa nje na kuifunika kwa shaba.

vi.L: Vua làm sân của các thầy tế lễ, và sân lớn, và các cửa cho sân; và vua bọc các cửa ấy [bằng] đồng.
vi.B: Vua làm sân của các thầy tế lễ và sân lớn, cùng các cửa cho sân, và vua bọc các cửa ấy bằng đồng.
vi.R: Vua làm sân dành cho các thầy tế lễ và một sân lớn bên ngoài. Vua làm các cửa cho sân ngoài và bọc chúng bằng đồng.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 제사장들의 뜰과 큰 뜰과 그 뜰의 문들을 만들고, 그 문들을 놋으로 입혔다.
ko.B: 그는 제사장들의 뜰과 큰 뜰을 만들고, 뜰에 문들을 달아 그 문들을 놋으로 입혔다.
ko.R: 그는 제사장들이 쓰는 뜰과 그 바깥의 큰 뜰을 만들었다. 그리고 바깥뜰에 문들을 만들어 달고 놋으로 덮었다.

pt.L: E fez o pátio dos sacerdotes e o pátio grande, e portas para o pátio; e cobriu as suas portas [de] bronze.
pt.B: Ele fez o pátio dos sacerdotes e o grande pátio, com portas para o pátio, e revestiu as portas de bronze.
pt.R: Ele fez o pátio dos sacerdotes e o grande pátio de fora. Fez portas para o pátio de fora e as cobriu de bronze.

decisions.choice: two courts: an inner court for the priests and a large outer court
decisions.reason: The court of the priests surrounded the temple and held the altar and the Sea; 1 Kings 6:36 calls it "the inner court". The great court lay outside it, where the people gathered (2 Chronicles 6:13; 20:5). 1 Kings 7:12 speaks of "the great court" around the palace and temple buildings.

decisions.choice: court: a second word for an enclosed court
decisions.reason: The verse uses two words for a court. The second, used for the great court, appears in this sense only in Chronicles and Ezekiel (Ezekiel 43:14; 45:19), and also names a ledge of the altar there.

decisions.choice: no parallel in 1 Kings 7
decisions.reason: Kings tells of the courts in 6:36 and 7:12 but not of doors overlaid with bronze. This verse is found only in Chronicles.

decisions.choice: large outer courtyard; outer courtyard
decisions.reason: Readable says the great court was the outer one (m1) and that the doors were for it.

decisions.choice: "atrio" (L, B); "patio" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable says "courtyard", Spanish Readable says "patio", the plain word for an enclosed court.

decisions.choice: "le parvis" (court of the priests), "la grande cour"
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew words for court (m2) are kept apart: "parvis" for the first, "cour" for the second; Readable says "cour" for both and adds "extérieure", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: o pátio (both words)
decisions.reason: Portuguese "pátio" serves for both Hebrew words for a court (m2), as 1 Kings 6:36 has "o pátio interno"; the great court is "o grande pátio", and Readable adds "de fora", as the English adds "outer".

source.text: וְאֶת־הַיָּ֗ם נָתַ֞ן מִכֶּ֧תֶף הַיְמָנִ֛ית קֵ֖דְמָה מִמּ֥וּל נֶֽגְבָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the sea he put on [the] shoulder of the right, eastward, from in front of [the] south.

en.L: And he put the sea on the right side, eastward, toward the south.
en.B: He put the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner.
en.R: He put the Sea near the southeast corner of the temple.

es.L: Y el mar lo puso al lado derecho, al oriente, hacia el sur.
es.B: Puso el Mar en el lado sur, en la esquina sureste.
es.R: Puso el Mar cerca de la esquina sureste del templo.

fr.L: Et il plaça la mer du côté droit, vers l’est, en direction du sud.
fr.B: Il mit la Mer du côté sud, à l’angle sud-est.
fr.R: Il a mis la Mer près de l’angle sud-est du temple.

sw.L: Na bahari akaiweka upande wa kuume, upande wa mashariki, kuelekea kusini.
sw.B: Bahari akaiweka upande wa kusini, kwenye pembe ya kusini-mashariki.
sw.R: Bahari akaiweka karibu na pembe ya kusini-mashariki ya hekalu.

vi.L: Vua đặt biển ở phía bên phải, về phía đông, hướng về phía nam.
vi.B: Vua đặt cái Biển ở phía nam, nơi góc đông nam.
vi.R: Vua đặt cái Biển gần góc đông nam của đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 바다는 오른쪽 옆, 동쪽, 남쪽을 향해 두었다.
ko.B: 바다는 성전 남쪽, 동남쪽 모퉁이에 두었다.
ko.R: 바다는 성전의 동남쪽 모퉁이 가까이에 놓았다.

pt.L: E pôs o mar no lado direito, para o leste, em direção ao sul.
pt.B: Pôs o Mar no lado sul, no canto sudeste.
pt.R: Ele pôs o Mar perto do canto sudeste do templo.

decisions.choice: as in 1 Kings 7:39
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:39 gives the same place, with "of the house" after "side".

decisions.choice: the right side: the south
decisions.reason: The temple faced east, so its right side is the south, as the end of the verse makes clear (verse 6).

decisions.choice: south side; southeast corner
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "south" for right (m2), as 1 Kings 7:39. Readable adds "of the temple", which Kings has.

source.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ חוּרָ֔ם אֶת־הַ֨סִּיר֔וֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִ֖ים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָק֑וֹתסוַיְכַ֣ל חוּרָ֗ם לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בְּבֵ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And made Huram the pots and the shovels and the bowls; and finished Huram to do the work which he did for the king Solomon in [the] house of God:

en.L: And Huram made the pots and the shovels and the bowls. And Huram finished doing the work that he did for King Solomon in the house of God:
en.B: Huram also made the pots, the shovels and the sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished the work that he did for King Solomon on the house of God:
en.R: Huram also made pots, shovels and bowls for sprinkling. So he finished the work he did for King Solomon on God's temple. This is what he made:

es.L: E hizo Huram las ollas y las palas y los tazones. Y terminó Huram de hacer la obra que hizo para el rey Salomón en la casa de Dios:
es.B: Huram hizo también las ollas, las palas y los tazones para rociar. Así terminó Huram la obra que hizo para el rey Salomón en la casa de Dios:

decisions.choice: as 1 Kings 7:40, with pots, Huram and God
decisions.reason: This verse and the list after it (verses 11-18) repeat 1 Kings 7:40-47. Chronicles has "pots" where Kings has "basins" in this verse; Kings has "pots" in its list (7:45). Chronicles says "the house of God" where Kings says "the house of Yahweh".

decisions.choice: Huram: spelled as read
decisions.reason: The craftsman is called Huram in Chronicles and Hiram in Kings. The second time, the written Hebrew has a different spelling of the name, and the reading tradition gives "Huram" as in the first. It is the same man, the bronze worker of 2:12-13 and 1 Kings 7:13-14.

decisions.choice: pots, shovels and bowls: tools for the altar
decisions.reason: The pots carried away the ashes and the shovels cleared them from the altar (Exodus 27:3). The bowls caught the blood of the sacrifices (verse 8).

decisions.choice: a colon at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: The list of verses 12-16 spells out "the work", so Literal and Balanced end the verse with a colon. Readable adds "This is what he made", as in 1 Kings 7:40.

decisions.choice: "Huram" for the craftsman
decisions.reason: Chronicles calls the craftsman Huram where 1 Kings 7:40 has Hiram (meaning decision); the rest keeps the Spanish Kings wording.

decisions.choice: "Houram" for the craftsman
decisions.reason: The craftsman is Hiram in French Kings and Houram here, as each book spells him (m2), like the king of Tyre in 2:2.

decisions.choice: "Hu-ram", "các nồi", "nhà của Đức Chúa Trời" where 1 Kings 7:40 has Hiram, basins and the house of the LORD
decisions.reason: Chronicles' differences from the parallel (m1); otherwise the Vietnamese of 1 Kings 7:40 is kept.

decisions.choice: "후람" for the craftsman
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the craftsman's name Huram as it spells the king's; Korean keeps 후람 for both, as 1 Kings keeps 히람 for both.

decisions.choice: Hurão; as panelas; as pás; as bacias
decisions.reason: Verses 11-18 repeat 1 Kings 7:40-47 (m1), and the Portuguese of 1 Kings is kept at every level, with Chronicles' differences: "panelas" where Kings has "pias", "a casa de Deus", and the craftsman's name "Hurão" (m2), the man of 2:12, where Kings writes "Hirão".

es.B: y las ollas, las palas y los tenedores para la carne. Todos estos objetos que Huram-abí hizo para el rey Salomón para la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} eran de bronce bruñido.
es.R: y ollas, palas y tenedores para la carne. Todos estos objetos que Huram-abí hizo para el rey Salomón para el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estaban hechos de bronce bruñido.

fr.L: et les marmites, et les pelles, et les fourchettes ; et tous leurs objets, Houram-Abi [les] fit pour le roi Salomon [pour] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, [en] bronze poli.
fr.B: et les marmites, les pelles et les fourchettes à viande. Tous ces objets que Houram-Abi fit pour le roi Salomon pour la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} étaient en bronze poli.
fr.R: et des marmites, des pelles et des fourchettes à viande. Toutes ces choses que Houram-Abi a faites pour le roi Salomon pour le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} étaient en bronze poli.

sw.L: na vyungu na sepetu na nyuma; na vyombo vyao vyote Huramu-abi alimfanyia mfalme Sulemani [kwa ajili ya] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, [vya] shaba iliyosuguliwa.
sw.B: na vyungu, sepetu na nyuma za nyama. Vitu hivi vyote ambavyo Huramu-abi alimfanyia mfalme Sulemani kwa ajili ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} vilikuwa vya shaba iliyosuguliwa.
sw.R: na vyungu, sepetu na nyuma za kushikia nyama. Vitu hivi vyote ambavyo Huramu-abi alimfanyia mfalme Sulemani kwa ajili ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} vilitengenezwa kwa shaba iliyosuguliwa ikang'aa.

vi.L: và các nồi, các xẻng và các nĩa; và tất cả các vật dụng của chúng, Hu-ram A-bi làm cho vua Sa-lô-môn [cho] nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, [bằng] đồng đánh bóng.
vi.B: cùng các nồi, các xẻng và các nĩa xiên thịt. Tất cả những vật dụng Hu-ram A-bi làm cho vua Sa-lô-môn cho nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đều bằng đồng đánh bóng.
vi.R: cùng các nồi, các xẻng và các nĩa xiên thịt. Tất cả những vật Hu-ram A-bi làm cho vua Sa-lô-môn dùng trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đều làm bằng đồng đánh bóng.

ko.L: 솥들과 부삽들과 고기 갈고리들이다. 그리고 그것들의 모든 기구를 후람아비가 솔로몬 왕을 위하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집[에] 빛나는 놋으로 만들었다.
ko.B: 솥과 부삽과 고기 갈고리이다. 후람아비가 솔로몬 왕을 위하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 만든 이 모든 기구는 광을 낸 놋으로 만든 것이었다.
ko.R: 솥과 부삽과 고기 갈고리이다. 후람아비가 솔로몬 왕을 위하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 만든 이 모든 기구는 반짝이게 닦은 놋으로 만들었다.

pt.L: e as panelas, e as pás, e os garfos; e todos os seus utensílios Hurão-Abi fez para o rei Salomão [para] a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, [de] bronze polido.
pt.B: e as panelas, as pás e os garfos para carne. Todas essas peças que Hurão-Abi fez para o rei Salomão para a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} eram de bronze polido.
pt.R: e panelas, pás e garfos para carne. Todas essas coisas que Hurão-Abi fez para o rei Salomão para o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} eram feitas de bronze polido.

decisions.choice: forks: 1 Kings 7:45 has "bowls"; all their vessels
decisions.reason: Where 1 Kings 7:45 has "bowls", Chronicles has "forks", the three-pronged forks used to take meat from the pot (1 Samuel 2:13-14; Exodus 27:3). The bowls were named in verse 11. Kings has "all these vessels" where Chronicles has "all their vessels".

decisions.choice: Huram his father: the name or title Huram-abi
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "Huram his father". As in 2:12, where the king of Tyre calls him "Huram my father", it is taken as part of his name or as a title of honor for a master craftsman, as "father" is used of Joseph in Genesis 45:8. It does not mean that he was Solomon's father.

decisions.choice: polished bronze: burnished to a shine
decisions.reason: The word means rubbed or polished, as in 1 Kings 7:45.

decisions.choice: Huram-abi
decisions.reason: Every level gives the name as one, Huram-abi, as at 2:12 (m2). Balanced and Readable say "meat forks" to show what the forks were for.

decisions.choice: "Huram-abí"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "Huram his father" is taken as the name of 2:12 (meaning decision), written the same way.

decisions.choice: nyuma (Literal); nyuma za nyama (Balanced); nyuma za kushikia nyama (Readable)
decisions.reason: The three-pronged forks of the altar are "nyuma", the word of the Swahili Exodus 27:3, where Readable also says what they held.

decisions.choice: "후람아비" as one name, as in 2:12
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "Huram his father"; the English and the word data take it as the name of 2:12.

decisions.choice: os garfos (L), os garfos para carne (B, R); Hurão-Abi
decisions.reason: The forks (m1) are "garfos", as Exodus 27:3 has them in Portuguese, and Balanced and Readable add what they were for, as the English does. The name is "Hurão-Abi", as in 2:12 (m2); the rest keeps 1 Kings 7:45 in Portuguese.

source.text: בְּכִכַּ֤ר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יְצָקָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ בַּעֲבִ֖י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה בֵּ֥ין סֻכּ֖וֹת וּבֵ֥ין צְרֵדָֽתָה׃

records.literal_gloss: In [the] plain of the Jordan cast them the king, in [the] thickness of the ground, between Succoth and between Zeredah.

en.L: In the plain of the Jordan the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
en.B: The king cast them in the clay ground of the Jordan plain, between Succoth and Zeredah.
en.R: The king had them cast in molds made in the clay soil of the Jordan Valley, between the towns of Succoth and Zeredah.

es.L: En la llanura del Jordán los fundió el rey, en la tierra arcillosa entre Sucot y Sereda.
es.B: El rey los fundió en la tierra arcillosa de la llanura del Jordán, entre Sucot y Sereda.
es.R: El rey los hizo fundir en moldes hechos en la tierra arcillosa del valle del Jordán, entre los pueblos de Sucot y Sereda.

fr.L: Dans la plaine du Jourdain, le roi les fondit, dans la terre argileuse, entre Soukkoth et Tseréda.
fr.B: Le roi les fit fondre dans la terre argileuse de la plaine du Jourdain, entre Soukkoth et Tseréda.
fr.R: Le roi les a fait couler dans des moules faits dans la terre argileuse de la vallée du Jourdain, entre les villes de Soukkoth et de Tseréda.

sw.L: Katika uwanda wa Yordani mfalme akavisubu, katika ardhi ya udongo wa mfinyanzi kati ya Sukothi na Sereda.
sw.B: Mfalme alivisubu katika ardhi ya udongo wa mfinyanzi katika uwanda wa Yordani, kati ya Sukothi na Sereda.
sw.R: Mfalme aliagiza visubiwe katika kalibu zilizofanywa kwa udongo wa mfinyanzi katika Bonde la Yordani, kati ya miji ya Sukothi na Sereda.

vi.L: Tại đồng bằng Giô-đanh vua đúc các vật ấy, trong đất sét, giữa Su-cốt và Xê-rê-đa.
vi.B: Vua cho đúc các vật ấy trong đất sét của đồng bằng Giô-đanh, giữa Su-cốt và Xê-rê-đa.
vi.R: Vua cho đúc các vật ấy trong những khuôn làm bằng đất sét ở thung lũng sông Giô-đanh, giữa hai thành Su-cốt và Xê-rê-đa.

ko.L: 요단 평지에서 왕이 숙곳과 스레다 사이의 진흙 땅에서 그것들을 부어 만들었다.
ko.B: 왕은 요단 평지, 숙곳과 스레다 사이의 진흙 땅에서 이것들을 부어 만들었다.
ko.R: 왕은 요단 골짜기에 있는 숙곳 성읍과 스레다 성읍 사이의 진흙 땅에 틀을 만들고, 거기에 놋을 부어 이것들을 만들게 했다.

pt.L: Na planície do Jordão o rei os fundiu, no chão de barro, entre Sucote e Zereda.
pt.B: O rei os fundiu no chão de barro da planície do Jordão, entre Sucote e Zereda.
pt.R: O rei mandou fundir essas peças em moldes feitos no barro do vale do Jordão, entre as cidades de Sucote e Zereda.

decisions.choice: Zeredah: 1 Kings 7:46 has Zarethan
decisions.reason: This verse repeats 1 Kings 7:46, except that it names Zeredah where Kings has Zarethan. The two names are close in Hebrew and probably refer to the same place near the Jordan; a Zeredah in Ephraim is also named in 1 Kings 11:26.

decisions.choice: the thickness of the ground: clay soil used for molds
decisions.reason: The phrase means "thick" or dense ground, that is, clay. The clay of the Jordan valley was suited for making the large molds into which the bronze was poured, as in 1 Kings 7:46.

decisions.choice: the king cast them: the king had them cast
decisions.reason: Huram did the work (verses 11, 16). The king is named as the one who ordered it.

decisions.choice: had them cast in molds; the towns of
decisions.reason: Readable says the king had the work done, that the clay was used for molds (m2), and that Succoth and Zeredah were towns, as in 1 Kings 7:46.

decisions.choice: "Sereda"
decisions.reason: Chronicles names Zeredah where 1 Kings 7:46 has Zarethan (meaning decision); Spanish writes "Sereda", the form the Spanish of 1 Kings 11:26 uses for Zeredah.

decisions.choice: Sereda
decisions.reason: Zeredah is "Sereda", the form the Swahili 1 Kings 11:26 uses for the same name, while 1 Kings 7:46 has Sarethani (m1).

decisions.choice: "Xê-rê-đa"
decisions.reason: Chronicles names Zeredah where 1 Kings 7:46 has Zarethan (m1); the form follows the name in 1 Kings 11:26.

decisions.choice: Zereda
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:46 in Portuguese at every level, with the place named as Chronicles names it (m1), in the form 1 Kings 11:26 gives "Zereda" in Portuguese, where Kings here has "Zaretã".

source.text: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה כָּל־הַכֵּלִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לָרֹ֣ב מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֛י לֹ֥א נֶחְקַ֖ר מִשְׁקַ֥ל הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And made Solomon all the vessels the these in abundance very, for not was searched out [the] weight of the bronze.

en.L: And Solomon made all these vessels in very great abundance, for the weight of the bronze was not found out.
en.B: Solomon made all these things in such great numbers that the weight of the bronze was never found out.
en.R: Solomon made so many of these things that no one ever knew how much all the bronze weighed.

es.L: E hizo Salomón todos estos utensilios en gran abundancia, porque no se averiguó el peso del bronce.
es.B: Salomón hizo todos estos objetos en tan gran cantidad que nunca se supo el peso del bronce.
es.R: Salomón hizo tantos de estos objetos que nadie supo nunca cuánto pesaba todo el bronce.

fr.L: Et Salomon fit tous ces objets en très grande abondance, car on ne chercha pas à connaître le poids du bronze.
fr.B: Salomon fit tous ces objets en si grand nombre qu’on ne connut jamais le poids du bronze.
fr.R: Salomon a fait tant de ces objets que personne n’a jamais su combien pesait tout le bronze.

sw.L: Sulemani akafanya vyombo hivi vyote kwa wingi mno mno, kwa maana uzito wa shaba haukujulikana.
sw.B: Sulemani alifanya vitu hivi vyote kwa wingi kiasi kwamba uzito wa shaba haukujulikana kamwe.
sw.R: Sulemani alifanya vitu hivi vingi mno hata hakuna mtu aliyejua kamwe shaba yote ilikuwa na uzito kiasi gani.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn làm tất cả các vật dụng ấy rất, rất nhiều, vì trọng lượng của đồng không được tính ra.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn làm tất cả những vật ấy nhiều đến nỗi trọng lượng đồng không bao giờ được biết.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn làm nhiều vật bằng đồng đến nỗi không ai biết số đồng ấy nặng bao nhiêu.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 이 모든 기구를 매우 많이 만들었다. 놋의 무게를 알아내지 못했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 솔로몬은 이 기구들을 너무나 많이 만들어서 놋의 무게가 얼마인지 끝내 알 수 없었다.
ko.R: 솔로몬이 놋으로 만든 기구가 너무 많아서, 놋이 얼마나 쓰였는지 아무도 몰랐다.

pt.L: E Salomão fez todos estes utensílios em muitíssima abundância, porque o peso do bronze não foi averiguado.
pt.B: Salomão fez todas essas peças em tão grande quantidade que o peso do bronze nunca foi calculado.
pt.R: Salomão fez tantas dessas peças que ninguém nunca soube quanto o bronze pesava.

decisions.choice: Solomon made: 1 Kings 7:47 has "Solomon left"
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:47 says that Solomon left the vessels unweighed because there were so many. Chronicles says that Solomon made them in great numbers. Both end with the bronze too much to weigh.

decisions.choice: in abundance very: in very great numbers
decisions.reason: "Abundance" with "very" stresses how great the amount was. Kings doubles "very"; Chronicles has it once.

decisions.choice: the bronze: taken in David's wars
decisions.reason: 1 Chronicles 18:8 says David took a great amount of bronze from the cities of Hadadezer, from which Solomon made the Sea, the pillars and the bronze vessels. 1 Chronicles 22:3, 14 say David stored up bronze beyond weighing.

decisions.choice: things
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word covers tools, vessels and furnishings of every kind. Balanced and Readable say "things" because the list includes pillars and stands, as in 1 Kings 7:45; Literal keeps "vessels".

decisions.choice: fez (where 1 Kings 7:47 has deixou); utensílios (L), peças (B, R)
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:47 in Portuguese with Chronicles' verb "fez" (m1). The Hebrew word covers vessels and tools of every kind, as there: "utensílios" at Literal, "peças" at Balanced and Readable.

records.literal_gloss: And made Solomon all the vessels which [were for the] house of God: and the altar of the gold, and the tables, and on them [was] the bread of the Presence;

en.L: And Solomon made all the furnishings that [were for] the house of God: the altar of gold, and the tables, and on them [was] the bread of the Presence;
en.B: Solomon also made all the furnishings of the house of God: the altar of gold; the tables for the bread of the Presence;
en.R: Solomon also made all the furnishings for God's temple: the gold altar for burning incense; the tables for the bread set out before God;

es.L: E hizo Salomón todos los utensilios que [eran para] la casa de Dios: el altar de oro, y las mesas, y sobre ellas [estaba] el pan de la Presencia;
es.B: Salomón hizo también todos los utensilios de la casa de Dios: el altar de oro; las mesas para el pan de la Presencia;
es.R: Salomón hizo también todos los utensilios para el templo de Dios: el altar de oro para quemar incienso; las mesas para el pan que se ponía delante de Dios;

fr.L: Et Salomon fit tous les objets qui [étaient pour] la maison de Dieu : l’autel d’or, et les tables, et sur elles [était] le pain de la Présence ;
fr.B: Salomon fit aussi tous les objets de la maison de Dieu : l’autel d’or ; les tables pour le pain de la Présence ;
fr.R: Salomon a aussi fait tous les objets pour le temple de Dieu : l’autel d’or pour brûler l’encens ; les tables pour le pain qu’on plaçait devant Dieu ;

sw.L: Sulemani akafanya vyombo vyote [vilivyokuwa vya] nyumba ya Mungu: madhabahu ya dhahabu, na meza, na juu yake [ulikuwa] mkate wa Uwepo;
sw.B: Sulemani alifanya pia vyombo vyote vya nyumba ya Mungu: madhabahu ya dhahabu; meza za mkate wa Uwepo;
sw.R: Sulemani alifanya pia vyombo vyote vya hekalu la Mungu: madhabahu ya dhahabu ya kufukizia uvumba; meza za mkate uliowekwa mbele za Mungu;

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn làm tất cả các vật dụng [cho] nhà của Đức Chúa Trời: bàn thờ bằng vàng, và các cái bàn, trên đó [có] bánh Thánh Diện;
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn cũng làm mọi vật dụng trong nhà của Đức Chúa Trời: bàn thờ bằng vàng; các cái bàn để bánh Thánh Diện;
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn cũng làm mọi vật dụng cho đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời: bàn thờ bằng vàng để đốt hương; các cái bàn để bày bánh dâng trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời;

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 하나님의 집에 [둘] 모든 기구를 만들었다. 금 제단과, 그 위에 얼굴의 빵을 두는 상들과,
ko.B: 솔로몬은 또 하나님의 집에 둘 모든 기구를 만들었다. 금 제단, 임재의 빵을 차려 놓는 상들,
ko.R: 솔로몬은 또 하나님의 성전에 둘 모든 기구를 만들었다. 향을 피우는 금 제단, 하나님 앞에 차려 놓는 빵을 올려놓는 상들,

pt.L: E Salomão fez todos os utensílios que [eram para] a casa de Deus: o altar de ouro, e as mesas, e sobre elas [estava] o pão da Presença;
pt.B: Salomão fez também todos os objetos da casa de Deus: o altar de ouro; as mesas para os pães da Presença;
pt.R: Salomão também fez todos os objetos para o templo de Deus: o altar de ouro para queimar incenso; as mesas para os pães da Presença, que eram colocados diante de Deus;

decisions.choice: as 1 Kings 7:48, with "God" and "the tables"
decisions.reason: Verses 19-22 repeat 1 Kings 7:48-50. Here Chronicles says "the house of God" for "the house of Yahweh", and "the tables" where Kings has one table (see verse 8).

decisions.choice: the golden altar: the altar of incense
decisions.reason: The gold-covered altar stood in the main hall in front of the inner room. Incense was burned on it, as on the altar of incense in the tabernacle (Exodus 30:1-10).

decisions.choice: the bread of the Presence
decisions.reason: Twelve loaves were set out on the table before Yahweh each Sabbath (Exodus 25:23-30; Leviticus 24:5-9). The name means bread set "before the face" of Yahweh.

decisions.choice: for burning incense; the bread set out before God
decisions.reason: Readable says what the altar was for (m2) and explains "the bread of the Presence" (m3), as in 1 Kings 7:48.

decisions.choice: "bánh Thánh Diện" (L, B); "bánh dâng trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 7:48; Readable explains the bread of the Presence (m3).

decisions.choice: "얼굴의 빵" (L); "임재의 빵" (B); "하나님 앞에 차려 놓는 빵" (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 7:48.

decisions.choice: o altar de ouro; o pão da Presença (L), os pães da Presença (B, R)
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:48 in Portuguese at every level (m1), with Chronicles' "as mesas" and "a casa de Deus"; the bread (m3) keeps the words of Exodus 25:30 as there.

source.text: וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹר֞וֹת וְנֵרֹתֵיהֶ֗ם לְבַעֲרָ֧ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֛ט לִפְנֵ֥י הַדְּבִ֖יר זָהָ֥ב סָגֽוּר׃

records.literal_gloss: and the lampstands and their lamps, to burn them according to the ordinance before the inner room, gold pure;

en.L: and the lampstands and their lamps, to burn according to the ordinance before the inner room, [of] pure gold;
en.B: the lampstands and their lamps of pure gold, to burn in front of the inner sanctuary as prescribed;
en.R: the lampstands and their lamps, all of pure gold, to burn in front of the inner room as the law said;

es.L: y los candelabros y sus lámparas, para que ardieran según la ordenanza delante del cuarto interior, [de] oro puro;
es.B: los candelabros y sus lámparas de oro puro, para que ardieran delante del santuario interior como estaba prescrito;

decisions.choice: 1 Kings 7:49 gives the places; Chronicles gives the purpose
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:49 says five lampstands stood on the right and five on the left before the inner room. Chronicles gave their places in verse 7 and here says the lamps were to burn "according to the ordinance" (Exodus 27:20-21).

decisions.choice: the inner room: the most holy place
decisions.reason: The word names the innermost room of the temple, where the ark stood (1 Kings 6:16, 19-20).

decisions.choice: pure gold: refined gold
decisions.reason: The word means closed or shut up, and with gold it describes the finest refined gold.

decisions.choice: inner sanctuary; inner room
decisions.reason: Balanced says "inner sanctuary" and Readable "inner room", as in 1 Kings 7:49.

decisions.choice: "el cuarto interior" (L); "el santuario interior" (B); "el lugar santísimo" (R)
decisions.reason: The devir follows the Kings terms note for Spanish, one wording per level.

decisions.choice: the flowers: blossoms on the lampstands
decisions.reason: The lampstand of the tabernacle had cups shaped like almond blossoms (Exodus 25:31-34). These were flower-shaped parts of the lampstands, as in 1 Kings 7:49.

decisions.choice: perfection of gold: gold of the best quality
decisions.reason: The rare word means completeness or perfection. With gold it describes the purest kind. Kings does not have this phrase.

decisions.choice: flower decorations
decisions.reason: Readable says what the flowers were (m1), as in 1 Kings 7:49.

decisions.choice: as flores, as lâmpadas, as pinças; a perfeição do ouro (L), do ouro mais fino (B, R)
decisions.reason: The parts of the lampstands take the words of 1 Kings 7:49 in Portuguese (m1). Chronicles adds the rare word for the best gold (m2): Literal keeps "perfeição", Balanced and Readable say "o ouro mais fino".

sw.B: makasi ya kukatia tambi, mabakuli ya kunyunyizia, sahani na vyetezo vya dhahabu safi; na mlango wa nyumba, yaani milango yake ya ndani ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu na milango ya nyumba ya ukumbi mkuu, ya dhahabu.
sw.R: makasi ya kukatia tambi, mabakuli ya kunyunyizia, sahani na vyetezo, vyote vya dhahabu safi; na milango ya dhahabu kwenye viingilio vya hekalu: milango ya ndani ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu na milango ya chumba kikuu cha hekalu.

decisions.choice: the entrance and its doors: 1 Kings 7:50 has the sockets for the doors
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:50 names "the sockets" of the doors, the pivots in which they turned, as gold. Chronicles has "the entrance of the house" and its doors. Kings also lists cups, which Chronicles leaves out here.

decisions.choice: snuffers, dishes, firepans: utensils for the lamps and the incense
decisions.reason: The snuffers trimmed the lamp wicks. The dishes held incense (Numbers 7:14), and the firepans carried burning coals (Leviticus 16:12).

decisions.choice: two sets of doors: the inner room and the main hall
decisions.reason: The doors of the most holy place and those of the main hall are described in 1 Kings 6:31-35. 2 Chronicles 3:14 adds a curtain for the most holy place.

decisions.choice: wick trimmers; the main hall
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "wick trimmers" and "main hall" (Readable "main room"), as in 1 Kings 7:50.

decisions.choice: "la nave" (L); "la sala principal" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Kings 6-7: the hekhal is "la nave" at Literal and "la sala principal" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: cortadores de pavio (L, B), tesouras para os pavios (R); colheres (L, B), panelinhas (R); braseiros (L, B), pás para carregar brasas (R)
decisions.reason: The utensils (m2) keep the words of 1 Kings 7:50 in Portuguese, where the Hebrew words are the same; "colheres" there follows Exodus 25:29 for the dishes that held incense. Chronicles has the doors themselves where Kings has their sockets (m1).
